# **Website Maintenance Plan \- Phase 4 (SEO & AEO)**

[https\://vintagefootball.shop/](https://vintagefootball.shop/)

*Total Estimate time: **65 hours***

# **1 . Clean up dead links, Sitemap Index & H1 Restructuring (8h)**

[https\://vintagefootball.shop/clubs/sevilla-clubs](https://vintagefootball.shop/clubs/sevilla-clubs)

**Issue:**  
Several dead links around website content. /shop/ is listed in both the page and product sitemaps. 8 utility pages such as login, registration and track-your-order are indexable and listed, while the /clubs/, /national-teams/ and /legends/ hub pages are linked but are in no sitemap. The home page and 10 other pages have no H1, and one product page has none either.

**Proposed action:**  
Remove the stale URLs, no-index the utility pages, add the three hub pages to the sitemap and give each page one H1. On the home page the H1 will use the main keyword phrase.

# **2 . Product Trust Signals & Policies (10h)**

**Goal:** Increase customer trust, reduce purchase hesitation, and support organic SEO.

Trust signals are especially important for an online store selling vintage and retro football shirts, where customers may have questions about product condition, authenticity and returns.

**2a . Product authenticity & condition**

For a vintage football shirt store, this is a key trust factor.

* Clearly distinguish original vintage shirts, new old stock and retro reproductions.  
* State product condition accurately, such as new with tags, excellent, good or signs of wear.  
* Include actual product photos and disclose defects, fading, print damage or missing tags where applicable.  
* Avoid terms such as “authentic” or “original” unless the claim can be substantiated.

Acceptance criteria: Customers can understand what they are buying before adding it to the cart.

**2b . Returns & refunds policy**

# **3 . Rebuild Product Schema (4h)**

**Issue:**  
Product pages output two separate Product entities (one with an empty description, one with the offer) and two different breadcrumb trails.

**Proposed action:**

Combine product schema to one

# **4 . Category Intros & FAQ BLocks (8h)**

![][image7]

**Issue:**  
27 of 143 categories have no intro text. 21 of them are legend pages such as /legends/messi/ and /legends/maradona/, and the others include /national-teams/portugal/, /national-teams/spain/, /clubs/real-betis/ and /kids/. Category pages have no questions and answers, and the /faqs/ page has no FAQPage markup.

**Proposed action:**  
Write unique intros for these 27 pages and add short FAQ blocks with FAQPage markup to the top 20 categories.

# **5 . Images Alt Text (15h)**

![][image8]

**Issue:**  
52,906 of 59,917 image tags on product pages (88%) have no alt text. This includes the main product image, which has alt="" and only a title attribute. Every one of the 1,153 crawled pages has images without alt text, and Search Console showed 0 image search clicks in September.

**Proposed action:**  
Add a template rule that writes descriptive alt text from club, season and kit type.

Build an AI tool one-off bulk update of the existing images.

# **6 . Lmms.txt and AI Crawler policy (4h)**

![][image9]

[https\://vintagefootball.shop/llms.txt](https://vintagefootball.shop/llms.txt)

**Issue:**  
The site has no llms.txt (it returns 404). robots.txt has no rules for GPTBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot or OAI-SearchBot, so none of them are blocked, and my test requests with those names returned 200\. Cloudflare bot rules that act on IP address cannot be checked from outside.

**Proposed action:**  
Publish a short llms.txt that describes the shop, its categories, shipping and returns, with links to the key hub pages. Set a clear AI crawler policy in robots.txt and check the Cloudflare bot settings in the dashboard.

# **7 . Content & Blog strategy (12h plus more)**

![][image10]

[https\://vintagefootball.shop/blog/](https://vintagefootball.shop/blog/)

**Issue:**  
There are no Blog post/article existing in website

**Proposed action:**  
Develop a blog covering football shirt history, classic matches, football legends’ stories, and related topics to attract organic traffic.

**Step by step:** Build Blog page \+ Post details template → Write content & publish first post → Plan to publish a post weekly or monthly.

**Idea: Create high-intent informational content clusters linking down into money categories:** 

1\. Topical Pillar 1: Kit Buyer Guides & Authenticity 

* "How to Spot Real vs Fake Vintage Football Shirts (Collector's Guide)" \-\> Links to /clubs/ and /national-teams/   
* "Retro Football Kit Sizing Guide: How Do 90s vs Modern Shirts Fit?" 

2\. Topical Pillar 2: Nostalgia & Historic Rankings 

* "Top 10 Most Iconic 90s Serie A Kits of All Time" \-\> Links to /clubs/ac-milan/, /clubs/as-roma/, etc.   
* "Every World Cup Winning Jersey Ranked (1970–2022)" \-\> Links to /national-teams/france/, /national-teams/argentina/, /national-teams/brazil/   
* "The Story Behind the Iconic Arsenal 1991-93 'Bruised Banana' Kit" \-\> Links to /clubs/arsenal/ 

3\. Topical Pillar 3: Player Legends 

* "The Greatest Shirts Worn by Zinedine Zidane"   
* "Ronaldo R9's Most Iconic Club and Country Jerseys"
